commercial_definition: Directionless airport-pair average each-way fare, nominal USD per passenger, all ticket classes; includes taxes/airport fees, excludes ancillary charges. Quarterly historical observations, not Super Bowl week quotes.
annual_method: Passenger-per-day weighted by days in each quarter; only complete four-quarter years.
fuel_definition: Annual U.S. Gulf Coast kerosene-type jet fuel spot price FOB, nominal USD per US gallon. Wholesale benchmark, not LAX FBO retail or a verified procurement cost.
private_historical_status: No verified consistent route-level 2016-present annual series located; missing values must remain unavailable, not zero.
super_bowl_2027_quotes_status: Not verified for February 11-15, 2027; published charter benchmarks are not dated quotes.
